title: Silicon Valley's herd mentality in cozying up to Trump backfired as Democrats may seek retribution, China closes the AI gap, and anti-Big Tech sentiment grows (Nick Clegg/The Atlantic)
summary: Nick Clegg / The Atlantic: Silicon Valley's herd mentality in cozying up to Trump backfired as Democrats may seek retribution, China closes the AI gap, and anti-Big Tech sentiment grows — For Silicon Valley leaders, cozying up to the Trump administration has led to a series of spectacular failures.
